name: opencode-webui-wasm
comment: WASM fallbacks for the web UI's native Rust bindings, which have no FreeBSD/arm64 builds. Versions must match rolldown / lightningcss / @tailwindcss-oxide in the OpenCode tree. @napi-rs/wasm-runtime is pinned because 1.2.6 requires an @emnapi version that does not match the one pinned by @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi.
